speech_verification.heard: Akrotiri is the Pompeii where nobody died. For centuries, many believed this buried city was a tomb. In 1967, Spirit and Maranatos began excavating the volcanic ash. He found three-story buildings and frescoes of swallows and red lilies. But unlike Pompeii, no human remains were found in the ruins. Proceeding earthquakes likely warned the population to pack and flee. Today, archaeologists find only a ghost town frozen in time.
